crossRefs.note: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’

translations.web: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling.
translations.bsb: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
translations.kjv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
